name: Railway bridge KW51, Leuven, Belgium

length.node_extent_note: span between the first and last girder node x-coordinates
length.bearing_span_note: distance between bearing nodes N1 (x=1.059) and N3 (x=115.257)

coordinate_system: x longitudinal along the bridge (0 near Brussels abutment); y transverse, side/girder A (South) at y=0, side/girder C (North) at y=11.750 m; z vertical up. Girder neutral axis z=0.2719 m; arch neutral axis z = -0.0056679878*x^2 + 0.659277672*x + 0.341695. From model_kw51.m and overview.pdf.

omitted_parts.reason: deck ballast surface, not a structural member needed for the inspection map; modeled as shell/plate in the FE model for load distribution only.

omitted_parts.part: orthotropic deck plate (shell4 elements, plate nodes 181xxx-196xxx)
omitted_parts.reason: deck surface plates (Type 3 'shell4'); not needed for the inspection-map geometry (girders, arches, diagonals, braces, and deck beams).

In model_kw51.m the transverse beams span the bridge width at each of 33 longitudinal x-stations (ytr = repmat([0, yu, 11.75]', 1, 33)), plus one orientation reference node per station at z=20 that is not a physical point. A single x-line cannot faithfully represent that y-grid, and the side elevation (x-z) does not draw transverse beams. Omitted rather than emitting nodes with an unresolved y coordinate.

diags_box_scheme.description: model_kw51.m input 'diags_box' codes documented retrofit boxes at diagonal connections. Scheme from model_kw51.m lines 52-55:

codes.10xx: track B, bottom (deck end), diagonal xx
codes.20xx: track B, top (arch end), diagonal xx
codes.30xx: track A, bottom (deck end), diagonal xx
codes.40xx: track A, top (arch end), diagonal xx

diags_box_scheme.note: Track-to-side mapping, read from the plan view in overview.pdf: Track B runs along side A (South, y=0) and Track A along side C (North, y=11.750). Therefore diags_box 10xx/20xx (track B) = side A, and 30xx/40xx (track A) = side C. This correspondence is from overview.pdf; it is not stated in model_kw51.m. Diagonal connections in this file are derived by geometry (side A/C, end deck/arch); the diags_box codes map to them via this note.

cross_checks.note: matches: bearing nodes N1 (x=1.059) to N3 (x=115.257).

cross_checks.quantity: arch crown height above model zero line
cross_checks.note: about 19.5 m extracted vs 19.63 m on the drawing; the model uses the arch centerline (neutral axis), so a small offset from the drawing's reference is expected.
overview.pdf numbers diagonal 1 at the Leuven end (high x) and 16 at the Brussels end (low x). Confirmed: diagonal 1 deck end x=105.058 m, diagonal 16 deck end x=11.258 m.

provenance.source: Finite element model of railway bridge KW51, KU Leuven (K. Maes, M. van de Velde, G. Lombaert)
provenance.note: derived geometry, not the original model. Ported from model_kw51.m and select_sensors.m; no FE analysis reproduced.
